ghats.name: Godavari Bathing Ghats & Kalyana Katta
ghats.description: Sacred bathing steps where Godavari flows southward (Dakshina Vahini). Features steel protective fencing, tonsure complexes, and Teppotsavam float points.

significance: Taking a holy dip (Nadi Snanam) in the south-flowing Godavari River at Bhadrachalam during Pushkarams, Ekadashi, or holy months cleanses sins and bestows divine merit.
safety_rules: Always remain inside steel safety fencing. Undercurrents and sudden deep drops exist. During monsoon (July-Sept), bathing is suspended if flood warnings are issued: First Warning (43 feet), Second Warning (48 feet), Third Warning (53 feet).
